newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STATE-OWNED EMEX Q1 PROFIT 5 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: STATE-OWNED EMEX Q1 PROFIT 5 MLN KROONS.

text.p: The Estonian Metal Company (EMEX), in which a majority stake is to be privatised, had net profit of 4.9 million kroons and turnover of 68.1 million kroons in the first quarter, it said on Tuesday.
"The profit is 20 percent of the year estimate of 24.9 million kroons," managing director Toomas Keridon told Reuters.
EMEX, which has a monopoly in scrap metal export and import, posted a net profit of 144,000 kroons and turnover of 50.77 million kroons in the first quarter of 1996.
The company had net profit of 18.7 million kroons and a turnover of 301.7 million kroons in 1996.
The closing date for the privatization tenders for a 51 percent stake in the company is May 8.
The privatization agency sold five percent of its shares last year for vouchers, which are traded now on the OTC market.
